product.description: Firma de pantofi Angelini, care realizează încalțăminte de lux la comandă de peste o sută de ani, fiind una dintre ultimele afaceri de familie din Greenwich Village, New York, se află în pragul falimentului. Tânăra Valentine Roncalli, nepoata și ucenica maestrei artizan Teodora Angelini, își dorește cu ardoare să salveze afacerea, dar pentru asta trebuie să o modernizeze, să o aducă în secolul XXI. Viața ei se împarte între datoria față de familie, povestea de dragoste cu maestrul bucătar Roman Falconi și provocarea profesională oferită de șansa de a participa la competiția organizată de un prestigios magazin new-yorkez. Călătorind în Italia să învețe tehnici noi și să găsească materialul cel mai potrivit pentru pantofii cu care își va dobori adversarii, Valentine își descoperă propriul simt artistic, dar și un secret de familie care îi vă schimba viața într-un mod cu totul neașteptat. Scrisă cu sensibilitate, dar și cu umor, cartea Adrianei Trigiani este o celebrare a dragostei, o desfătare pentru cititorul pasionat de experiențe de viață împlinite.

# Valentine (Format Mic) by Litera Brand

**Dive into a captivating story of love, artistry, and destiny with *Valentine*. This must-read novel from the Litera brand explores the delicate balance between honoring family tradition and embracing modern change.**

Are you ready for a narrative that is both deeply romantic and professionally challenging? *Valentine* follows the journey of Valentine Roncalli, a compelling character thrust into a dramatic situation involving her family's legacy. This beautifully written book promises an immersive reading experience for anyone who appreciates stories about fulfilling life experiences and enduring love.

## The Story: Saving a Family Legacy

The plot revolves around the storied Angelini shoe companyâa luxury brand established by shoemaker Angelini, which has been creating bespoke footwear in Greenwich Village, New York, for over a century. Unfortunately, the business now faces the brink of bankruptcy.

Valentine Roncalli, who is both the granddaughter and apprentice to master artisan Teodora Angelini, is determined to save this cherished family enterprise. To do so, she must modernize the company and bring it into the 21st century. Her life becomes intertwined with several powerful forces: her duty to the family name, a developing romance with the master chef Roman Falconi, and a professional challenge presented by a prestigious New York retailer.

## Journey of Discovery and Love

The narrative takes Valentine on an epic journey to Italy. There, she seeks new techniques and the perfect materials for the shoes that will allow her to defeat her rivals. Through this quest, she not only discovers her own artistic flair but also uncovers a secret family truth that changes her life in entirely unexpected ways.

Written with great sensitivity infused with humor, *Valentine* is hailed as a celebration of love and personal fulfillment. It is the perfect read for those drawn to rich character development and heartwarming stories about overcoming adversity through passion and skill.
